transcript: Speaker A (Waiter): Pehle main English sunkar dar jata tha. Aaj main English bolkar logon ko hairan kar deta hoon. [I used to be scared of English. Today, I surprise people by speaking it.] Speaker B (Customer): What is this? I specifically asked for a medium rare steak! English samajh nahi aati to shehar kyun chale aate ho? [If you don't understand English, why do you come to the city?] Speaker A: Mujhe bahut sharmindagi hui. Maine English Seekho app download kiya jisme AI Coach Disha ke sath practice ki. Kuch hafton baad wahi customer aaya aur maine confidence se English mein baat ki. Boss ne promotion ki baat ki. [I felt humiliated. I downloaded English Seekho app and practiced with AI Coach Disha. Weeks later, the same customer returned, and I spoke confidently. My boss even discussed a promotion.] Speaker C: Install now par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click install now and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An animated story of a waiter who faces humiliation from an English-speaking customer. He uses the English Seekho app to practice daily with an AI coach, successfully improves his skills, wins over the customer, and earns a promotion. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
